versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the respond-pr-feedback skill.
- Automatically replies to unreplied PR review comments after evaluation and fixes.
- Resolves conversation threads by default (can skip with --no-resolve).
- Groups summary output by reviewer and provides thread resolution stats.
- Enforces prerequisite evaluation and non-blind replies to review comments.
- Avoids @-tagging human reviewers; only bots are tagged to trigger re-processing.
